page.layout: One page of text: a three-column Greek verb table (label column at left, then two form columns), with headings in italic and capitals between the blocks. Running head at top with page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right.
page.notes: The Greek forms are copied as printed, with some letters uncertain in the scan (for example the accents on the Future and Subjunctive forms, and the final forms of the Infinitive rows). The catchword "Infinit" at bottom right is cut off and is only partly legible. Stains and show-through from the facing page are ignored.
